name: Add invoice document
description:
## POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/upload

Handles the uploading of a document to a invoice
whenToUse: Attach document files to one invoice via multipart upload; use to add files, not update_invoice for field edits (mutating).

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes
